rationale: Merge Aira Solar into Horizon New Energy because Horizon is CIP's Canadian manager-level platform and Aira is one of its Alberta development projects. Preserve Aira's regulatory, entity and project history on Horizon; retire the separate Aira company and its duplicate CI IV ownership period. Current registry evidence identifies CI V-named Horizon and Aira vehicles, while the 2025 amalgamation was an internal reorganization rather than a sale. Stake, exact entry close, FID, financing, construction start, offtaker and COD remain not publicly disclosed and are not inferred.

afterImage.description: Horizon New Energy is Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners' Canadian renewable-development platform. CIP launched Horizon in November 2023 with approximately 1.2 GW of Alberta solar, wind and battery-storage projects. Horizon lists the 450 MWac Aira Solar development near Seven Persons, Alberta as one of its projects; Aira is therefore an underlying project and associated SPVs rather than a second manager-level PortCo. Alberta registry records identify CI V Horizon New Energy Devco Ltd and CI V Aira entities, including a March 2025 internal amalgamation into CI V Aira Holdco Ltd. The project has received AESO connection and Alberta Utilities Commission approvals and remained active in AESO's August 2026 project list, but a final investment decision, financing close, construction start, offtaker and commercial-operation date were not publicly disclosed. No third-party platform sale, Aira transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: CIP established Horizon New Energy as a Canadian renewable-development platform with approximately 1.2 GW of initial Alberta projects.
CIP publicly launched Horizon New Energy and identified it as the platform for its existing Canadian development assets, including Alberta projects.
Horizon identified Aira Solar as an underlying 450 MWac Alberta project rather than a standalone operating platform.
Aira received AESO connection approval and Alberta project and substation approvals while remaining a Horizon development project.
AESO approved the Aira Solar Project connection under the abbreviated needs-approval process.
The Alberta Utilities Commission approved the Aira Solar Project and associated substation.
Aira Wind Power Inc. and CI IV Whisper Holdco Ltd amalgamated as CI V Aira Holdco Ltd in an internal reorganization, not a third-party sale of Aira or Horizon.
